description: Search the 173 available ClickUp API operations by keyword (and optional toolset). Returns operation names to use with clickup_describe_operation and clickup_call_operation.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'create task', 'time entry', 'doc page'. Empty lists all.

toolset.description: Optional toolset filter: attachments, audit_logs, authorization, chat, comments, custom_fields, custom_task_types, docs, folders, goals, guests, lists, members, privacy_and_access, roles, shared_hierarchy, spaces, tags, task_checklists, task_relationships, tasks, templates, time_tracking, user_groups, users, views, webhooks, workspaces

name: clickup_search_operations
